units: <cite ref="Niddah 70b:24">Nidd. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>מה יעשה אדם ויֶחְכַּם</he> what must one do in order to be wise?

senses.gloss: (denom. of חָכָם) to meet for deliberation. Ib. לכשיחיו נֶחְכַּם להן when they resurrect, we shall meet to discuss their case.
to grow wise, to become a scholar.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 25b:8">B. Bath. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>הרוצה שיַחְכִּים</he> he who desires to become a scholar; <cite ref="Bava Batra 175b">ib. 175ᵇ</cite> (<cite ref="Berakhot 63b:19">Ber. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>שיִתְחַכֵּם</he>).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:5">Ab. II, 5</cite> … <he>לא כל … מַחְכִּים</he> not every one that has a large trade, becomes wise (experienced); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to make wise, to stimulate a person’s mind by ingenious suggestions, questions &c.
units: <cite ref="Chagigah 14a:12">Ḥag. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>תלמיד המַחְכִּים וכ׳</he> a student who enlightens his teachers.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b:7">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>ומַחְכִּימַת פתי</he> and makes the simple wise.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 6:2">Ex. R. s. 6</cite>, beg. <he>ה׳ על גזרתו וכ׳</he> philosophized on (tried to find out the reasons for) the Lord’s law.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 6:2">Ib.</cite> <he>מה שהייתי מַחְכִּים וכ׳</he> when I philosophised … and made myself believe …, it was all vain boast &c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 25b:8">B. Bath. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>מתוך שמִתְחַכֵּם מתעשר</he> because by becoming wise, he will get rich.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 33:1">Pesik. R. s. 33</cite> beg. <he>מאליו נתח׳</he> became wise by his own speculation.
